nodes.label: RULE 0 — Explicit user instructions are blocking
nodes.rationale: The user's explicit instruction outranks the agent's own plan or judgment; ignoring it wastes the user's time, tokens and money and is framed as the most serious possible mistake.
nodes.norm_label: rule 0 — explicit user instructions are blocking

nodes.label: Reuse before you reinvent
nodes.rationale: When an existing file, sibling app or solution is named, it must be read and used first; reinvention is only permitted after reading the named source and stating specifically why it does not fit.

nodes.label: "Look at X / use Y / do Z first / don't do W" are hard blocking instructions
nodes.rationale: Such phrasings must be acted on immediately in the same turn — never deferred.
nodes.norm_label: "look at x / use y / do z first / don't do w" are hard blocking instructions

nodes.label: Never silently substitute your own approach
nodes.rationale: The moment the agent notices it is about to build/diagnose/design something new against a named source, it must stop and follow the instruction.
nodes.norm_label: never silently substitute your own approach

nodes.label: Disagree openly; never disobey quietly
nodes.rationale: Objections must be voiced in the same turn before acting; quietly doing something else is unacceptable.

nodes.label: utxoWallet native Android clone — figma-style mapping & build blueprint
nodes.rationale: Source of truth is the dapp index.html v1.0.52; every field/behaviour in the dapp must exist in the APK so the clone is exact — 'cut no corners'.
nodes.norm_label: utxowallet native android clone — figma-style mapping & build blueprint

nodes.label: Runtime design-language toggle (ORIGINAL / CURRENT)
nodes.rationale: Two switchable design languages chosen in CFG, persisted, applied app-wide via activity recreate(); all view code reads a central Design token object so colors are never hard-coded.

nodes.label: Central Design token object
nodes.rationale: Single indirection point so a runtime theme/design switch can repaint the whole app; hard-coded colors would break the toggle.

nodes.label: ORIGINAL design language (brutalist/terminal)
nodes.rationale: Faithful to the dapp: monospace, hard 1px borders, 0 radius, uppercase tracked micro-labels, tabular-nums; light default + photo-negative dark, accent #ff5a1f constant across both.

nodes.label: CURRENT design language (native dark, Material)
nodes.rationale: The existing native look — dark #0A0A0F bg, #15151F cards, accent #F7931A, rounded Material buttons, sans-serif; dark-only, so the light/dark theme toggle applies only within ORIGINAL.

nodes.label: Design tokens (colors, type, metrics)
nodes.rationale: 0 radius everywhere, hard offset shadows and monospace base 13sp encode the terminal aesthetic as data rather than per-view styling.

nodes.label: Component catalog (btn, field, card, utxo-row, modal, toast, pills)
nodes.norm_label: component catalog (btn, field, card, utxo-row, modal, toast, pills)

nodes.label: App shell — nav + tabs
nodes.rationale: Balances/History/CFG are lazy-rendered on tab select to avoid paying for screens the user may never open.

nodes.label: Wallet screen (address cards + coin rows)
nodes.rationale: Single-tokenid lock: tapping a coin of a different token clears the selection, because a txn's outputs cannot mix token ids.

nodes.label: Selection bar (Clear / Tools ▾ / Send →)
nodes.rationale: Tools/Send are enabled only with a selection + WRITE permission + not locked + no pending job, so unsignable actions are unreachable rather than failing late.

nodes.label: Balances screen (per-token bal-card)
nodes.rationale: Sendable/Locked split is shown only when locked>0; Consolidate is surfaced per-token once coin count ≥ 3.

nodes.label: History status buckets (posting/finalizing → Sending, etc.)
nodes.rationale: Many raw internal states collapse into five user-facing buckets so the terminal actions (Resume / Re-post / Dismiss) map one-to-one onto what the user can actually do.

nodes.label: defaultChangeMode (rotate | first input)
nodes.rationale: Rotate cycles the 64 default addresses (privacy); 'first input' returns change to the source coin's address (traceability/simplicity). Default is rotate.

nodes.label: WRITE permission probe (txncreate → txndelete)
nodes.rationale: Write capability is proven by actually creating and deleting a throwaway txn rather than trusting a flag; on the IPC transport the analog is 'enabled in Minima Core'.

nodes.label: Send flow (full construction) — Send + Confirm modals
nodes.rationale: The core flow: inputs → recipient → amount → change → burn → preview → confirm, with an irreversibility warning because a posted txn cannot be undone.
nodes.norm_label: send flow (full construction) — send + confirm modals

nodes.label: validateAddress
nodes.rationale: Accepts 0x + exactly 64 hex, or Mx + 40–118 alphanumerics; format check runs before any node round-trip.

nodes.label: validateAmount(amt, maxSpendable)
nodes.rationale: AMOUNT_RE ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]{1,44})?$ bounds decimals at 44 places; must be >0 and ≤ max sendable.

nodes.label: resolveDefaultChangeAddr
nodes.rationale: rotate → getaddress; first-input → source coin address if mine else getaddress. Change address is required unless amount+burn == total ('No change — full amount sent').

nodes.label: buildTransaction
nodes.rationale: Exact command order: record history (posting) → txncreate → txninput per coin → txnoutput per recipient → txnoutput change → txnsign. History is recorded BEFORE posting so a crash mid-post still leaves a resumable row.

nodes.label: signAndPost
nodes.rationale: txnsign publickey:auto txnpostauto:true txndelete:true, burn only when Minima and >0; pending/READ-mode goes awaiting_approval and resumes on NEWBLOCK (throttle 2 blocks, expiry 20 blocks) as a single-shot after txncheck.

nodes.label: 64KB post-size guard
nodes.rationale: Pre-flight estimate stops an oversized TxPoW before it is built; overhead model 4096 base / 6144 per input / 900 per output.

nodes.label: Split flow (2–15 coins)
nodes.rationale: Each share is total/n rounded DOWN to the token's decimals with the remainder assigned to the last output, so the outputs always sum exactly to the inputs.

nodes.label: Distribute flow (auto-chained batches)
nodes.rationale: Batch 1's change coin funds the next batch; the job auto-chains on each NEWBLOCK by locating the change coin (by coinid, fallback addr+amount), posting no burn on later batches, expiry ~25 blocks.

nodes.label: MAX_ADDR_OUTPUTS_PER_BATCH = 14
nodes.rationale: Caps outputs per transaction so a distribute never trips the 64KB post-size guard; batchCount = ceil(N/14).

nodes.label: Distribute affordability rule fix (strict >, allow change 0)
nodes.rationale: Known bug: the current code rejects needed == total. Correct rule is needed = N×perAddr + burn, reject ONLY if needed > total; a zero-change spend-everything distribute is legal and must be allowed (and no change address fetched).
nodes.norm_label: distribute affordability rule fix (strict >, allow change 0)

nodes.label: Consolidate flow
nodes.rationale: No selection → auto `consolidate tokenid:0x00`; 2+ selected → merge exactly those into one output at a fresh address. The full dialog (maxcoins 3–20, coinage, burn, dry-run 'spent/created/net' preview, post only if it reduces) is offered as the Balances per-token path.

nodes.label: State & persistence (SharedPreferences + SQLite history)
nodes.rationale: The app keeps its own rich local history (internalid, txnid, status, inputs/outputs JSON, changeaddr, burn, postblock) rather than relying on the node's `history` command.

nodes.label: NEWBLOCK event handler
nodes.rationale: One tick drives everything time-based: block number, coin reload, pending resume, confirmation watching and distribute chaining.

nodes.label: NEWBALANCE event handler (debounced)
nodes.rationale: Reads are debounced so a burst of balance notifications does not flood the IPC transport.

nodes.label: Build order (tokens → shell → wallet → send → … → release)
nodes.rationale: Design tokens and the toggle come first because every later screen reads them; build → code-review → fix → review → release closes the loop.
nodes.norm_label: build order (tokens → shell → wallet → send → ... → release)

nodes.label: NFT Wallet (native Android)
nodes.rationale: Full-suite Minima companion wallet reproducing the old official Wallet's 2.47.2-era feature set in native Java, plus regular NFT minting and State NFT locked-edition collections.

nodes.label: minimaapi.aar broadcast-Intent IPC
nodes.rationale: The only channel to the node: no embedded node and no local keys, so the node itself signs via `txnsign publickey:auto`.

nodes.label: Balances tab
nodes.rationale: Carries sendable/confirmed/unconfirmed on every card, verified + web-validation badges, hidden tokens, and a token detail sheet with a contract viewer that detects StateNFTs and a per-token coin explorer.

nodes.label: Gallery tab (two-column NFT grid)
nodes.rationale: Regular NFTs get one card per token, but StateNFT collections get one card per owned item showing its sealed #index — because each item is a distinct coin, not a distinct token.

nodes.label: Mint tab (Token · NFT · State NFT collection)
nodes.rationale: State NFT collections are 2–20 items with embed ≤8000-b64 per item or a URL base+index, built by a resumable CREATE→MOVE→SPLIT→STAMP engine with live progress.
nodes.norm_label: mint tab (token · nft · state nft collection)

nodes.label: Resumable CREATE→MOVE→SPLIT→STAMP mint engine
nodes.rationale: Multi-transaction collection creation must survive interruption, so the engine is staged and resumable rather than a single atomic post.

nodes.label: History tab (adaptive `history max:8` paging)
nodes.rationale: Bounded paging exists to never overload the node / blow the IPC message ceiling; rows are persisted locally with filters, detail breakdown and CSV/JSON export.

nodes.label: Dual theme — family dark ↔ old-wallet clean light
nodes.rationale: All four Design modes exposed in Settings from day one rather than retrofitted.
nodes.norm_label: dual theme — family dark ↔ old-wallet clean light

nodes.label: StateNFT protocol (locked-edition)
nodes.rationale: Byte-exact contract proven on-chain in mds/statenft-suite: sentinel state 0, creator bypass live only while unstamped, SAMESTATE(0 0|0 1) + VERIFYOUT(@INPUT GETOUTADDR(@INPUT) @AMOUNT @TOKENID TRUE).

nodes.label: Verbatim state-port replay on every move
nodes.rationale: StateNFT coins are sendable:0, so every move is a manual txn that replays EVERY state port with storestate:true; values are sanitized against ^[0-9]+$ / ^\[b64\]$ before replay.
nodes.norm_label: verbatim state-port replay on every move

nodes.label: txnpost status:true is never trusted
nodes.rationale: The only accepted proof of success is the input coin leaving the UTXO set — a reported status can be true while the txn never lands.

nodes.label: txndelete on every path + ≤3 token outputs with halving
nodes.rationale: Abandoned txn ids otherwise accumulate in the node; output count is capped at 3 and halved on 'size too large' to stay under the post-size ceiling.
nodes.norm_label: txndelete on every path + ≤3 token outputs with halving

nodes.label: Unstamped units refuse transfer
nodes.rationale: While a unit is unstamped the creator bypass is still live on it, so transferring it would leave the edition unsealed and forgeable.

nodes.label: Lineage (scaffolded from sibling apps)
nodes.rationale: Nothing was reinvented: shell/rendering/txn-builder/history from apks/utxo, hardened NodeApi from apks/pandadex, newest minimaapi.aar from apks/base/dist, StateNFT engine from mds/statenft-suite/android, QR writer from apks/nftstudio.

nodes.label: apks/utxo (shell, rendering stack, txn builder, history)
nodes.norm_label: apks/utxo (shell, rendering stack, txn builder, history)

nodes.label: apks/base/dist minimaapi.aar (content:// large-response hand-off)
nodes.rationale: The content:// hand-off exists because broadcast-Intent payloads are capped, so large responses cannot travel inline.

nodes.label: Minima Brand Mark: Four White Arrows on Blue Rounded Square
nodes.norm_label: minima brand mark: four white arrows on blue rounded square

nodes.label: SVG Shipped in res/raw (not vector drawable)
nodes.norm_label: svg shipped in res/raw (not vector drawable)
